# Wordwise

> Wordwise is a freelance SEO copywriting and website service based in Dorking, Surrey. We help local UK businesses get found on Google through SEO content, website builds, and Google Business Profile optimisation.

## Services

- Website design — clean, fast, mobile-friendly websites for local businesses
- SEO services — keyword research, on-page optimisation, locally targeted content
- SEO blog writing — keyword-researched articles for small business websites
- Google Business Profile — setup, optimisation, and management
- Monthly content packages — consistent publishing for sustained Google visibility
- Website SEO audits — free audits identifying title tag, meta description, content, and technical issues

## Target clients

Independent UK small businesses — yoga studios, Pilates studios, photographers, tradespeople, cleaning companies, wellness practitioners, care homes, landscapers, and professional services across Surrey, Sussex, Hampshire, and South London.
